mapper.sql: POLICY_ID, INSR_CLS_CD, FACTOR_TYPE, REQUIRED_YN, EFF_FROM, EFF_TO
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PRM_FACTOR_POLICY WHERE INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND REQUIRED_YN = TRUE AND EFF_FROM <= #{on} AND (EFF_TO IS NULL OR EFF_TO >= #{on})
SELECT FROM TB_PRM_FACTOR_POLICY WHERE INSR_CLS_CD = #{insrClsCd} AND FACTOR_TYPE = #{factorType} ORDER BY EFF_FROM
SELECT FROM TB_PRM_FACTOR_POLICY ORDER BY POLICY_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRM_FACTOR_POLICY (INSR_CLS_CD, FACTOR_TYPE, REQUIRED_YN, EFF_FROM, EFF_TO) VALUES (#{insrClsCd}, #{factorType}, #{required}, #{effFrom}, #{effTo})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PRM_FACTOR_POLICY SET EFF_TO = #{effTo} WHERE POLICY_ID = #{policyId}
